field.label: Enabled
field.help: Enable this client. Apply starts it when the global Xray service is enabled; disabling it stops only this client.

field.label: Name
field.help: Descriptive name shown in the Clients, Diagnostics and Log selectors.

field.label: Server
field.help: Remote VLESS server address. Use the address or hostname from the server configuration or VLESS link.

field.label: Port
field.help: Remote VLESS TCP port, usually 443 when REALITY is exposed on HTTPS-like traffic.

field.label: UUID
field.help: VLESS user UUID issued by the remote server. It must exactly match the server-side client entry.

field.label: Flow
field.help: Leave empty unless the server requires a VLESS flow such as xtls-rprx-vision.

field.label: Network
field.help: VLESS transport used by the remote server: raw, XHTTP or gRPC. Transport-specific fields below are applied only to the selected mode.

field.label: XHTTP Mode
field.help: XHTTP transfer mode. It must be compatible with the remote Xray configuration; auto lets Xray select the normal behavior.

field.label: Path
field.help: XHTTP request path. It must start with / and match the server-side XHTTP path.

field.label: XHTTP Host
field.help: Optional HTTP Host value for XHTTP. Leave empty unless the remote server or reverse proxy explicitly requires it.

field.label: Enable XHTTP Padding
field.help: Add XHTTP padding. The remote Xray server must use compatible XHTTP settings.

field.label: Padding Bytes
field.help: Amount of XHTTP padding to add when padding is enabled. Accepts a single positive byte count or an inclusive range such as 100-1000.

field.label: Padding Obfuscation Mode
field.help: Enable Xray XHTTP padding obfuscation for the generated padding value. The server must use compatible XHTTP behavior.

field.label: Padding Placement
field.help: header or cookie are the preferred choices for bidirectional padding experiments.

field.label: Padding Method
field.help: Select how padding content is generated. Keep the default unless the remote XHTTP profile requires a specific method.

field.label: Uplink HTTP Method
field.help: GET is valid only with packet-up mode.

field.label: Session ID Placement
field.help: Optional location for the XHTTP session identifier: path, header, cookie or query. Leave unset unless explicitly configured on the server.

field.label: Sequence Placement
field.help: Optional location for the XHTTP packet sequence value. Leave unset unless the server profile uses the same placement.

field.label: gRPC Service Name
field.help: gRPC serviceName used by the remote VLESS server. Leave empty when the server does not define one.

field.label: gRPC Authority
field.help: Optional gRPC authority value. Configure it only when the remote server or proxy expects a specific authority.

field.label: gRPC Multi Mode
field.help: Enable Xray gRPC multiMode. It must match the transport behavior expected by the remote server.

field.label: Security
field.help: Transport security mode. This plugin release supports VLESS with REALITY.

field.label: SNI
field.help: REALITY serverName/SNI from the remote server profile. It is required and must match a name accepted by the server.

field.label: Public Key
field.help: REALITY public key of the remote server. Copy it exactly from the server configuration or VLESS link.

field.label: Short ID
field.help: Optional REALITY shortId. If the server defines one, copy the same hexadecimal value here; otherwise leave it empty.

field.label: SpiderX
field.help: Optional REALITY spiderX path. Use the value from the server profile or VLESS link; leave it empty when the server does not specify one.

field.label: Fingerprint
field.help: uTLS client fingerprint presented by REALITY. Use the value expected by the server profile; chrome is a common default.

field.label: SOCKS5 Listen Address
field.help: Internal loopback listener between HEV and Xray.

field.label: SOCKS5 Port
field.help: Local loopback port used only between HEV and this Xray instance. It must be unique across Xray clients; new clients receive the next free port automatically.

field.label: TUN Interface
field.help: FreeBSD tun(4) device created for this client, for example tun0. It must be unique and not used by another OPNsense interface or service.

field.label: TUN Address
field.help: Plugin-owned transit address assigned to the TUN. HEV on FreeBSD requires an IPv4 /32; new clients receive a free 169.254.x.1/32 address automatically.

field.label: MTU
field.help: MTU applied to this TUN interface. Default is 1500; reduce it only when the routed path requires a smaller packet size.

field.label: Gateway Health Sync
field.help: Mirror end-to-end Xray proxy health into a native OPNsense static Far Gateway Force Down state so Gateway Groups can fail over. Assign and enable this TUN, keep IPv4/IPv6 configuration at None, and keep Dynamic Gateway Policy disabled. The plugin creates or adopts the synthetic Far Gateway automatically.

field.label: Xray Log Level
field.help: Verbosity of the per-client Xray core log. warning is suitable for normal use; debug can be very noisy and is intended for troubleshooting.
